title: iris × germanica var. illyrica
intro: Iris × germanica var. illyrica, commonly known as Illyrian iris, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the iris family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Illyrian iris include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
